preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the rebase() function with a large multiple (e.g., type(uint256).max / currentRebaseMultiple) to make rebaseMultiple extremely large. This will cause arithmetic overflow in calculations like amount * rebaseMultiple in transfer(), transferFrom(), approve(), etc., making all token transfers fail and effectively halting the contract.
